category_title: Children with co-occurring Autism and Anxiety
minimal_context: The student and a peer are in a play-session with plastic tracks and a motor car to practice unstructured constructive play.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Here are the plastic tracks and the motor car. You and your classmate can play with them now.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Grabs the motor car away from the peer without speaking and stares at the spinning wheels, ignoring the tracks.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You need to build the track with your partner.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Drops the car, looks around the room, and starts wandering away from the play area instead of helping plan the track.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Come back and figure out how to put the pieces together.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Suddenly runs toward the door to leave the room, ignoring the peer and the activity completely.)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Here are the plastic tracks and the motor car. You and your classmate can play with them now.

STUDENT: (Grabs the motor car away from the peer without speaking and stares at the spinning wheels, ignoring the tracks.)

TUTOR: You need to build the track with your partner.

STUDENT: (Drops the car, looks around the room, and starts wandering away from the play area instead of helping plan the track.)

TUTOR: Come back and figure out how to put the pieces together.

STUDENT: (Suddenly runs toward the door to leave the room, ignoring the peer and the activity completely.)

task.content: unstructured constructive play, for example, a set of plastic tracks with a motor car that could move
task.learning_goal: practice positive social skills. Structured constructive play. Conflicts resolution, problem-solving, sharing, helping.

context.materials: set of plastic tracks with a motor car that could move
context.social_setting: ratio of adults to children in the play-sessions was proposed to be 1:2 –1:4 or one more peer from the child’s class was nominated

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: executive functioning such as planning, decision making, problem solving and evaluation
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: attention problems, impulse control issues, and social difficulties

behavior_patterns.condition: executive functioning such as planning, decision making, problem solving and evaluation
